title: Fir and Ackee Ethiopian Breakfast
description: A traditional Ethiopian breakfast dish featuring roasted fir and ackee. This recipe combines the flavors of the fir tree with the creamy texture of ackee.

ingredients.name: Ackee
ingredients.notes: Canned or fresh, drained and chopped

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the fir needles, ground ginger, cumin, turmeric, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add the chopped ackee and stir well. Cook for 2-3 minutes.
Warm the injera bread by wrapping it in a damp cloth and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the breakfast dish by placing the fir and ackee mixture on top of the warmed injera bread.
